answer: Trust attaches to a task, not to an address. Each completed task carries its own score and that score decays 8% per epoch without a fresh submission from the same identity. Attestations on a task are weighted by independent path length, so a ring funded from one ferrous wallet adds a single path however many members it has. A relic of an identity that stops working keeps its history and loses its weight. The echo of a bought account fades inside three epochs, which is the planning horizon an attacker has to beat.
